sections.name: 听力 Listening
sections.intro: 大家好！欢迎参加HSK五级考试。HSK五级听力考试分两部分，共45题。请大家注意，听力考试现在开始。

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.desc: 请选出正确答案。每题是两个人的对话，第三个人问一个问题。
parts.audioIntro: 第一部分，共20题。每题听一次。每题都是两个人的两句对话，第三个人根据对话问一个问题，请选出正确答案。

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.desc: 请选出正确答案。四到五句对话，或一段话后的问题。
parts.audioIntro: 第二部分，共25题。每题听一次。每题都是两个人的四到五句对话，或者一个人说一段话，第三个人根据对话或者这段话问一个或几个问题，请选出正确答案。

parts.rangeIntro: 第{a}到{b}题是根据下面一段话：

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.desc: 选词填空。请选出正确答案。

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.desc: 请选出与试题内容一致的一项。

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.prompt: 请结合下列词语（要全部使用，顺序不分先后），写一篇80字左右的短文。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-30 (HSK 5 essay with 5 given words, ~80 characters; count every character incl. punctuation, as on the answer sheet):
27-30 = all 5 words used correctly and naturally; coherent, well-organised text with a clear topic; varied, level-appropriate grammar; almost no errors; 80+ characters
21-26 = all words used, mostly correctly; coherent; some minor grammar or word-choice errors; length about right
15-20 = most words used (4/5) or some used wrongly; understandable but loosely connected; several errors
8-14 = only 2-3 words used, or many errors that sometimes block meaning, or well under 60 characters
1-7 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5). Deduct 3 for each missing required word beyond the first.

parts.prompt: 请结合这张图片写一篇80字左右的短文。
parts.rubric:
Score 0-30 (HSK 5 picture essay, ~80 characters; count every character incl. punctuation, as on the answer sheet):
27-30 = clearly based on the picture and develops it into a coherent short story or description with a point; varied, level-appropriate grammar and vocabulary; almost no errors; 80+ characters
21-26 = relevant and coherent; some minor errors; length about right
15-20 = relevant but thin or loosely connected; several errors
8-14 = weak link to the picture, or many errors that sometimes block meaning, or well under 60 characters
1-7 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).
